name: ruflo-deepseek-harness
description: DeepSeek harness integration for ruflo — one-shot chat (deepseek-chat) and reasoning-mode completions (deepseek-reasoner, with chain-of-thought surfaced separately) via the OpenAI-compatible DeepSeek API. Reads DEEPSEEK_API_KEY; optional, removable augmentation per ADR-150 that degrades gracefully when the key is unset or the API is unreachable.
